content:
Headquarters: Bengaluru, India



About us

group.one is a dynamic and innovative company at the forefront of technology and digital solutions. Our commitment to excellence and our passion for cutting-edge advancements make us a leader in the industry. Within group.one, we have Rank Math, founded in 2020, is the Swiss Army knife of SEO tools, trusted by millions of WordPress users. We’re a small, passionate, fully remote team that's part of group.one - one of Europe’s top digital service providers. We believe in flexible schedules, asynchronous communication, and buildingimpactful products together.

We’re not just building a product - we’re creating the future of SEO in WordPress. If that excites you, we’d love to hear from you. Let’s build something extraordinary together.


About the role

Rank Math is calling for a Product Manager who's equal parts strategic thinker, UX advocate, and SEO Nerd. You’ll lead the charge in building features that empower millions of WordPress users to dominate search rankings. This is your chance to own the roadmap and ship game-changing SEO tools.


Why This Role Stands Out

AI isn’t just a buzzword at Rank Math - it’s core to our product strategy. This is a real opportunity to lead the development of AI-powered tools that help users automate, optimize, and scale their SEO performance. As Product Manager, you’ll play a key role in shaping and shipping these intelligent features.

What You’ll Be Doing

o Defining product vision and roadmap based on customer needs, SEO trends, and competitive analysis.

o Collaborating with engineering, design, and marketing teams to deliver features that drive user adoption and retention.

o Leading cross-functional planning to ensure on-time delivery and alignment across stakeholders.

o Partnering with support and growth teams to ensure product-market fit and measurable outcomes.

o Conducting user research, gathering feedback, and analyzing usage data to inform product decisions.

o Leading customer onboarding and experience improvements during our SaaS transition.

o Implementing product analytics tools to track engagement, retention, and feature adoption.

o Working closely with the customer support and success teams to identify pain points and continuously improve user satisfaction.

o Keeping abreast of changes in SEO practices, search engine algorithms, and the WordPress ecosystem.

o Creating clear, concise product requirement documents (PRDs) that align with business goals.

o Championing a culture of experimentation and continuous learning through A/B testing and feedback loops.

Ideal Background

o 5+ years of product management experience, ideally with WordPress or SEO-related products.

o Proven track record of managing technical products from concept to launch.

o Strong understanding of SEO fundamentals and user needs in the WordPress community.

o Experience working on SaaS products, especially within the WordPress or marketing tools space.

o Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

o Familiarity with tools like HubSpot, Jira, Figma, and product analytics platforms is a plus.

Apply now and let’s make SEO magic happen!



To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/saas-product-manager
